strategy.thesis: Australia's longest-running deep-tech incubator, providing custom wet labs, offices and specialist equipment to scientist- and engineer-founded startups. It runs a dedicated HealthTechHub at Westmead and, separately, was appointed by CSL, WEHI and the University of Melbourne as independent operator of the Jumar Bioincubator, giving it a direct biomedical translation mandate alongside its broader deep-tech portfolio.

program.location: National Innovation Centre, Eveleigh NSW; HealthTechHub at Westmead

summary.en: Sydney-based deep-tech incubator offering wet-lab and office space to scientist-founders, with a dedicated Westmead HealthTechHub and prior appointment as independent operator of Melbourne's Jumar Bioincubator.

strategy.thesis: Wet-lab biotech incubator co-located inside CSL's global headquarters in the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct, jointly established by CSL, WEHI and the University of Melbourne with Victorian Government (Breakthrough Victoria Fund) support. Provides affordable, purpose-built wet-lab facilities and equipment plus commercialisation education, investor access and industry mentoring to resident biotech startups; operated independently by Cicada Innovations.

program.location: CSL Global Headquarters, Melbourne Biomedical Precinct, Parkville VIC

summary.en: Melbourne biotech wet-lab incubator inside CSL's new global HQ, jointly backed by CSL, WEHI, the University of Melbourne and Victoria's Breakthrough Victoria Fund; named its first 16-startup cohort of resident biotechs.

sources.title: Melbourne biotech incubator to drive transformative medical discoveries
sources.quote: Located over two floors of CSL's new corporate headquarters being built in the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct, the incubator will have one floor of purpose-built wet lab space and another for meetings, office and collaboration space.

sources.title: $65m biotech incubator names first 16 residents
sources.quote: Of the 16 ventures to take up residency, all but one – 23Stands, a Sydney startup – are based in Melbourne.

strategy.thesis: National non-dilutive biotech incubator delivered by commercialisation firm Brandon BioCatalyst in partnership with CSIRO, funded by the Australian Government's Medical Research Future Fund. Provides up to $5M in milestone-tranched grant funding plus mentorship and industry access to translate early-stage Australian therapeutics from discovery through preclinical and clinical development.

investment.raw: $1M–$5M per project (Stage 1: $1–1.5M preclinical or $1–2.5M clinical; Stage 2 top-up available)

program.eligibility: Australian SMEs (<200 employees) or university/institute researchers willing to incorporate a new company; therapeutics addressing significant unmet medical needs

summary.en: Australia's national biotech incubator, funded by the Medical Research Future Fund and delivered by Brandon BioCatalyst with CSIRO, giving early-stage therapeutics ventures up to $5M in non-dilutive funding plus commercialisation support.

sources.title: OPEN ROUND: BioMedTech Incubator
sources.supports: program operator, funding structure, source, eligibility
sources.quote: Brandon BioCatalyst manages the CUREator program in partnership with CSIRO... Australian Government's Medical Research Future Fund (MRFF) through the Department of Health, Disability and Ageing.

sources.title: BioMedTech Incubator Program Opens New Funding Round
sources.supports: track record: capital raised and patients reached
sources.quote: In just four years, CUREator-supported companies have attracted more than $150 million in external investment capital, with 10,000 patients benefiting through clinical trials and implementation.

strategy.thesis: Australia's national virtual incubator for vaccines, vaccine-related technologies and immunotherapies for infectious disease prevention, backed by a $32.9M MRFF 2024 BioMedTech Incubator grant. Provides up to $5M non-dilutive funding plus strategic guidance to three cohorts of innovators over four years, targeting influenza, COVID-19, HIV, TB and antimicrobial resistance.

investment.raw: up to AUD $5 million per innovator; $32.9 million total program grant

summary.en: Newly launched (Nov 2025) national virtual biotech incubator for vaccines and infectious-disease immunotherapies, funded by a $32.9M Medical Research Future Fund grant and run by health-sector consultancy Biointelect.

sources.quote: Biointelect Venturer (BV) is Australia's national, virtual incubator for vaccines, vaccine-related technologies, and immunotherapies for the prevention of infectious diseases, backed by a $32.9 million MRFF 2024 BioMedTech Incubator grant.

sources.title: Biointelect Venturer to launch to drive vaccine and infectious disease innovation
sources.quote: Biointelect Venturer officially launched on 17 November 2025... the first intake commencing work in early Q3 2026.

strategy.thesis: Australia's leading digital and connected health accelerator. Its flagship ANDHealth+ program provides up to $5M in tranched non-dilutive funding (delivered via the Australian Government's MRFF BioMedTech Incubator Program) plus in-kind support and investor/clinician networks to evidence-based digital and connected health SMEs; also runs the Victoria-focused ACTIVATE accelerator and a Masterclass: ACCELERATE program.

summary.en: Australia's national digital health accelerator; ANDHealth+ has supported 28 cohort/alumni companies that have collectively raised $170.4M and run 81 clinical trials, funded in part by a $33M federal government boost.

sources.title: ANDHealth+ | Australia's leading digital & connected health accelerator
sources.supports: program structure, funding amount, founding year, track record
sources.quote: Since 2017 ANDHealth has worked with over 935 digital & connected health companies across Australia... up to $5 million non-dilutive project funding, tranched according to agreed milestones.

sources.title: Digital health accelerator ANDHealth+ secures $33m boost
sources.supports: federal funding amount and cohort outcomes
sources.quote: To date 28 ANDHealth+ cohort and alumni companies have raised $170.4M investment, generated $59.0M in new revenue, undertaken 81 clinical trials, created 467 new jobs and impacted 1,239,744 patients.

strategy.thesis: Australia's largest medical-device-focused accelerator, running a milestone-driven six-to-fifteen-month cohort program for early-stage MedTech, HealthTech and BioTech startups (diagnostics, implants, therapeutics, robotics, precision medicine) in partnership with the Australian Government, VC firm Artesian, MTPConnect and industry partners including Medtronic and Johnson & Johnson, with a pathway to $3M+ in pre-seed to Series A investment.

program.eligibility: Startups incorporated in Victoria (or majority based / deeply connected there) driving MedTech, HealthTech or BioTech human health innovation; incorporated before program start with at least one actively participating co-founder

summary.en: Melbourne-headquartered national medtech accelerator backed by Artesian and MTPConnect, running cohort-based programs that connect MedTech/HealthTech/BioTech startups with corporate partners (Medtronic, J&J) and pre-seed-to-Series-A capital.

sources.quote: The Actuator is engaged in close partnership with the Australian Government, Artesian, MTP Connect, and a range of industry partners (including Medtronic and Johnson & Johnson).

strategy.thesis: Australasia's largest private deep-tech incubator, combining 4,500 sqm of specialised wet-lab, containment-facility and hardware-workshop space in Auckland with a deep-tech venture fund and founder community; medical technologies are one of its four core focus areas alongside energy, aerospace and infrastructure.

program.location: 24 Balfour Road & 40 Kenwyn Street, Parnell, Auckland

summary.en: Auckland deep-tech incubator and venture fund offering wet labs, containment facilities and hardware workshops to ~20+ resident startups at a time, with medical technologies as one of four core focus verticals.

strategy.thesis: University of Western Australia-delivered biomedical entrepreneurship fellowship modeled on the Stanford Biodesign process, training multidisciplinary teams of clinicians, engineers, researchers and business professionals to identify unmet clinical needs and build medtech / digital-health startups; part of the WA Life Sciences Innovation Hub ecosystem.

summary.en: Perth-based, Stanford-Biodesign-modeled fellowship (launched 2018) that trains clinician-engineer-business teams to identify unmet clinical needs and build medtech (7-month track) and digital-health (3-month track) startups, delivered by UWA.

sources.title: Perth Biodesign
sources.quote: Perth Biodesign launched in 2018 after co-founder Matt Oldakowski completed Stanford Biodesign's global faculty training program... The flagship, 7 month part-time course involves teams of engineers, clinicians, researchers and business professionals who find unmet clinical needs and create a medical technology solution.

sources.title: WA Life Sciences Innovation Hub
sources.quote: Support includes networking events, seminars and workshops, funding consultation and grant review, commercialisation consultation and advice, delegation support, and upskilling opportunities, including Perth Biodesign.

verification_notes: Program details drawn from search-engine summaries of the official site rather than a direct page fetch; cohort size and application cycle not independently confirmed.

strategy.thesis: New Zealand's only dedicated deep-tech incubator with global reach, operating as the venture arm of the US-based Bridgewest Group. Backs biotech, medtech and life-science ventures alongside AI/ML, clean tech and advanced sensors, drawing on Group affiliate BioDuro-Sundia (described as the world's third-largest CRDMO) for pharma/biotech operational expertise.

summary.en: Auckland-network deep-tech incubator and VC arm of the US Bridgewest Group, founded 2020, investing in biotech, medtech and life-science startups alongside AI/ML and clean-tech, with access to the Group's CRDMO affiliate BioDuro-Sundia.

sources.title: Bridgewest Ventures - New Zealand's Deep Tech Incubator With Global Reach
sources.supports: founding year, sector focus, Group affiliation
sources.quote: Bridgewest Ventures was established in 2020... invests in deep tech sectors such as clean technology, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), medical technology (medtech), life sciences, and advanced sensors... including the world's third-largest CRDMO (BioDuro-Sundia).
